Name: Kedemoth
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Reuben's allotment, east of the Jordan
Description: A town and wilderness in Reuben's allotment, from which Moses sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon asking passage, and which was later given to the Levites.
BiblicalSignificance: Kedemoth is where Moses' messengers asked Sihon for passage, and a Levitical city afterward.
